steps.speaker: Sadistic Female Voice
steps.content: Did I tell you to move your legs? Stupid dog!

steps.speaker: Elysiland Guest A
steps.content: I, I'm sorry! Punish me, please punish me! Ahhh!
The sound of a whip slashing through the air and an uncontrollable cry of pleasure come from the beach.

steps.speaker: Elysiland Guest B
steps.content: Ahhh!!!

steps.speaker: Elysiland Guest B
steps.content: Wait, I'm not dead? I'm not dead! I'm still alive!!! Oh my god, that near-death rush of adrenaline feels so good!!!

From further out in the sea come screams of dying victims and cheers of relieved survivors. Everyone is intoxicated by this dangerous pleasure, even craving more, not bothering to hide this bizarre addiction.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Oh? Do these happenings really please them so much?

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: A paradise "full of laughter where everyone enjoys themselves." The eternally blissful Elysiland... It really is something.
That colorful website looked suspicious, but the tagline claiming everyone can find happiness still piqued Serpent's curiosity enough that she clicked it open.
Next thing she knew, she found herself standing on an unknown island. Although there is constant laughter around, it almost all comes first from painful screams.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Are people truly into these things that hurt them and cause them pain?

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: And here I am thinking that only when they watch others despair and flirt with danger from a safe spot, they're thrilled enough to spare a tip... Am I wrong?
Joy comes in many forms!
Serpent's surprise draws the island owner to her. She emerges beside her effortlessly, like a pretty little fish.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: And Elysiland is exactly the place where they can all exist freely! There are no restrictions here, so everything is possible!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: You should try something that interests you too! With so many choices available, there's bound to be something that brings you joy!
L.L. twirls in the water proudly. Countless bubbles rise and drift to different corners of the island, as if showing off to Serpent the variety of entertainment abundant here.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Something that brings me joy? That might be difficult. Just like it's probably hard to please you too. That's why you go to such lengths to devise these strange ways of entertainment, right?

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: I can only feel joy when I see others find it. So, according to you, how should I seek my own joy here?
Serpent smiles, but there's an edge to her words, just like the faintly visible fangs between her pink lips.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Oh, I forgot, you're the owner of Elysiland! This question shouldn't be too hard for you, right?

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: You're not gonna tell me you can't grant my wish and bring me joy, are you?
L.L. and Serpent stand face to face, like two pretty reflections in a mirror of water.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Of course not! Don't worry, I understand the pain everyone faces and know how to replace it with true joy!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Including yours! You've found that beyond your performance, there are many other things that can please people, a kind of joy you can't comprehend or provide...

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: That's why you're upset and annoyed. Am I right?

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: I like the way you talk. You sound just like me. So tell me, your little trick, what's it gonna be?
L.L. wants to touch Serpent's fang but withdraws her hand smilingly when she receives a glare.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: There's none! I simply want you to know that the fun provided here doesn't contradict your belief. They even complement each other!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Just go and experience all the joyful activities on the island yourself. Understand them, digest them, and integrate them into your own performance!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Maybe then, you'll be able to bring joy to everyone on the island!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: You might just create the most unique kind of joy, making Elysiland burst into unprecedented satisfaction and pleasure because of you!
Her words flow out like honey, the sweet temptation hooking Serpent's most greedy desires.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Wow bingo! This is indeed an opportunity! A chance to experience the most diverse, unrestrained, and personal joys!

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: It'll allow me to please even more people and enrich my dreams with even more unique forms of joy!
Her desire awakened, Serpent immediately embarks on a tour of Elysiland, leaving L.L. who cheers her on contentedly.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: That's right! Elysiland will surely suit your needs! No place can offer more unique and comprehensive joy!
She cups her face in excitement, watching Serpent's back as she enters one facility after another. Her words tremble, her face flushes, and her voice rises higher!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: The joy of binge eating, of exercising, of being controlled, of trampling on others... Stack it up! This joy has no end! Experience it all!

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: So this is... the accumulation of joy? Numbers keep growing, money keeps rolling in... Another zero, the sense of achievement of breaking yet another record...

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: So this is how it feels for those addicted to someone else's control... The relief of surrendering all thoughts, obligations, and burdens...

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Aside from the taste buds' rapture, swallowing alone can bring such pleasure... Turning everything into a part of you, from opening the mouth, savoring, chewing, to swallowing, every step is so joyful...
Serpent traverses the island, moving through spaces built by the guests' various desires, observing their expressions and behaviors, tasting and sharing their rapture.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Where else haven't I been... Where's more joy to be had...
Her consciousness gorged with overstimulation, Serpent feels dazed with satiation. As she exits the building, something falls out of her pocket.
The hard object hits the ground, and the cover automatically opens.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: I want to know... more, more forms of joy...
At that moment, a crisp and bright music box melody suddenly plays. The tinkling tune stands out starkly in the rich, decadent atmosphere.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: What is... this sound? It sounds familiar...
She turns around and picks up the small box. Inside the circus tent, the carousel keeps spinning and spinning. The thin metal plates vibrate, gradually syncing the music with Serpent's heartbeat.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: It sounds... so familiar...

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Am I... dreaming again?
The gray figure in the dream is growing clearer. He breaks through the fog and walks forward, the slowly rising hand exuding a calming strength. Serpent stares at the warm palm and smiles.
steps.female_content: The gray figure in the dream is growing clearer. She breaks through the fog and walks forward, the slowly rising hand exuding a calming strength. Serpent stares at the warm palm and smiles.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: I know, as long as I'm by your side, I won't feel pain.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Even if I wake from the dream, it's okay.
The moment she grabs the person's hand, the music stutters, and Serpent's body turns into white powder, disappearing from Elysiland.
